description: Dependency-aware CP1 persistence and parameter verification. Independent quantization, Sidecar format, Base-generation binding and pinned-BSP Flash-map source audit run concurrently after storage/FM6 foundations; Sidecar A/B selection joins its prerequisites before pair-commit stages.

stages.title: Pinned BSP XDATA1 and update-record exclusion audit
stages.blocker: The source audit validates the candidate XDATA1 window and loader marker exclusion only. It does not allocate sectors, enable writes, or replace production build/link qualification.
stages.enable_when: The pinned BSP and loader source-level range/exclusion audit is committed with a host-only test.

stages.title: Sidecar schema, envelope and semantic validation
stages.blocker: Sidecar V1 envelope and identity/length/value/motion validation are implemented and covered by the focused host acceptance suite. P_MC numeric-ID whitelist validation remains a later CP1.4.4 gate because IDs are intentionally not assigned.
stages.enable_when: V1 format implementation and strict host acceptance suite committed together.

stages.title: Exact Base-generation binding
stages.blocker: The internal st_current_meta() helper returns the exact selected, payload-CRC-validated Base copy, sequence, payload CRC and length. The host test compiles the real storage.c and Sidecar V1 source against simulated NOR and proves stale-generation rejection and fallback binding.
stages.enable_when: Real storage metadata helper and exact Base fingerprint acceptance test committed together.

stages.title: CP1.4.2 7-bit parameter quantization reference
stages.blocker: The host reference checks 30 continuous controls, source-step boundaries and mathematical nearest-code bounds. This is quantizer correctness evidence only; musical-resolution acceptance and legacy project/preset compatibility remain open.
stages.enable_when: The standalone strict-C11 quantization reference and all 30-control acceptance sweeps are committed.

stages.title: Sidecar A/B matching-copy selection
stages.blocker: Implemented explicit validated A/B copy reads in storage.c and orphan-aware Sidecar selector. Host acceptance covers exact Base match, orphan/stale candidates, matching-vs-newest distinction, wrap/tie, malformed records, outer CRC rejection and no-valid-copy initialization.
stages.enable_when: Real explicit A/B copy reader, selector and simulated-NOR acceptance test committed together.

stages.title: Backend-independent pair transaction coordinator core
stages.blocker: Coordinator core and simulated host fault-injection suite implemented. Production storage adapter, physical Sidecar map and callsite integration remain separate gates.
stages.enable_when: Core API, Sidecar-first ordering and simulated A/B fault-injection acceptance committed together.

stages.title: Felucca Base adapter + Sidecar callback integration on simulated NOR
stages.blocker: Pair-aware Base target selection, Sidecar callback contract, exact-pair recovery and NOR fault-injection host tests are implemented. The physical Sidecar backend and runtime callsite wiring remain separate gates.
stages.enable_when: The adapter is bound to st_read_copy_meta/st_save_to and the host test models NOR erase/program/page semantics and interrupted pair commits.

stages.title: Base + Sidecar pair transaction ordering
stages.blocker: The pinned BSP source audit now qualifies XDATA1 [0xE7000,0xFC000) as firmware-owned data space. FM6 owns [0xE7000,0xE8000); sectors 0xE8000 and 0xE9000 are candidate Sidecar A/B sectors before globals. The loader checks update-record markers at each sector +0xF00, so the backend must leave the final 256 bytes of each sector erased. Production storage_hw.c still rejects candidate writes. Pair commit remains blocked until the bounded production A/B backend, firmware build/link evidence, project/preset/autosave runtime wiring, FM6 staging arbitration, and exhaustive simulated-NOR acceptance are implemented. No physical sector is allocated and no device write path is enabled.

stages.title: Power-loss injection across every pair-commit phase
stages.blocker: The coordinator core fault matrix and adapter-level simulated NOR tests now cover Sidecar erase/payload/header/readback failures, Base erase/payload/header failures, orphan handling and byte-cut samples. This remains blocked pending a broader exhaustive phase matrix, a qualified production Sidecar backend and hardware-independent final acceptance after the physical map gate.

stages.title: Sidecar CRC, schema and semantic integrity
stages.blocker: Sidecar V1 envelope and semantic validation are implemented and host-tested. The numeric P_MC Motion-ID whitelist remains unfrozen, and no physical Sidecar A/B reader/backend is enabled. Keep this stage blocked until the whitelist and runtime serialization contract are frozen.

stages.title: Pair recovery and full Sidecar roundtrip
stages.blocker: Pair-aware Base + Sidecar recovery and logical payload roundtrip are now implemented in the host-tested adapter. Runtime project/preset/autosave callsites and full private/Motion serialization are not yet wired; no load path may rewrite storage.

stages.title: Archive V2 pair-aware restore and destination rebinding
stages.blocker: Archive V2 pair-aware restore is not implemented. Archive V1 must remain legacy-only and must not inherit unrelated Sidecar data.

stages.title: Sidecar autosave coordination with FM6 staging ownership
stages.blocker: An explicit FM6 staging reservation/ownership contract and Sidecar autosave deferral implementation are not present.

stages.title: Full focused host regression after all CP1 stages
stages.blocker: This final regression runs only after all preceding CP1 acceptance stages have passed.
stages.enable_when: All preceding stages are ready and pass.
